record.title: Qwen opens a two-week Qwen4-Max-Preview with multimodal input and a 1M-token context
record.summary: Qwen’s official Chinese platform documentation lists Qwen4-Max-Preview as a multimodal model with text, image and video input, default deep thinking, tool calling, structured output and compatibility with OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages APIs. The documented context limit is 1M tokens and the maximum output budget is 393,216 tokens shared by reasoning and the final answer. Preview access is Token Plan only, not pay-as-you-go, from Nov 11 through Nov 25, 2026 (UTC+8); the documentation says the preview will be retired afterward. These are provider specifications and availability terms, not measured quality, speed or long-context effectiveness; no comparative evaluation was inspected.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: Qwen’s official platform documentation lists Qwen4-Max-Preview as available through Token Plan from 2026-11-11 10:00 through 2026-11-25 24:00 (UTC+8), after which the preview is scheduled to be retired.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: The official specification lists text, image and video input, default deep thinking, function calling, web search, structured output, OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility, a 1M-token context and a 393,216-token maximum output budget shared between reasoning and final response.

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED
claims.text: The inspected documentation does not establish comparative capability, effective long-context performance, speed, reliability, model scale or usage cost relative to other frontier models.

evidence_gaps.description: No independent matched evaluation of the model’s reasoning, multimodal, coding, agentic or million-token-context performance was inspected.
The preview is subscription-only and time-limited; model-specific pricing, regional availability and usage limits were not established by the inspected page.

brief.importance_rationale: If the documented multimodal, long-context and tool-use configuration performs as described, it could change local model-selection and evaluation choices. The evidence is one short provider preview without independent measurements, so it is meaningful rather than field-shifting.
limitations: The capability and scale specifications are provider-reported; no model card with methodology or independent result was inspected.
A 1M-token context limit does not establish usable retrieval or reasoning quality at that length.
The 393,216-token maximum is a shared reasoning-plus-answer budget, not a demonstrated typical output or throughput.
Preview access requires Token Plan and is stated to end Nov 25, 2026; no pay-as-you-go rate or released weights were established.

technical.reproducibility: No model weights, benchmark data or independent evaluation were inspected. Specs and access rules are first-party documentation.
technical.strongest_baseline: No matched baseline or model benchmark appears in the inspected specification; no performance comparison is claimed here.

brief.title: Qwen opens a two-week Qwen4-Max-Preview with multimodal input and a 1M-token context
brief.why_it_matters: A new multimodal model with a documented million-token context, very large shared output budget and agent tools may affect frontier model evaluation and inference design. Its short preview-only subscription access and lack of inspected benchmark evidence sharply limit what can be inferred about practical capability or cost.
